items.prompt: Thanks for your message ___ the sales report.

explanation.en: A message about something is a message on that subject. At and by do not fit here.

items.prompt: I couldn't answer your call yesterday because I ___ in a meeting.

explanation.en: Yesterday is a finished time, so we use the past simple, not the present perfect.
explanation.es: Con «yesterday» se usa el pasado simple (was), no el present perfect.

items.prompt: Could we ___ our discussion until Monday?

explanation.en: Put off means to delay something until a later time.

items.prompt: I'll send you the figures as soon as I ___ them from finance.

explanation.en: After as soon as we use the present simple for a future action, not will.
explanation.es: Después de «as soon as» se usa el presente simple, no «will».

items.prompt: I'm happy to ___ you a hand with the slides if you need it.

explanation.en: The fixed phrase is give someone a hand, meaning to help them.

items.context: An email from a manager to all staff about a restructuring

items.prompt: Difficult ___ it may be to accept, the restructuring announced this morning is essential for our long-term survival.

explanation.en: Adjective + though + subject + may be is a formal concessive pattern meaning although it may be difficult. Even and despite cannot be used in this pattern.

items.prompt: We had no alternative ___ to reduce headcount by about ten per cent.

explanation.en: The fixed pattern is no alternative but to + infinitive, meaning no other choice.

items.prompt: Under no circumstances ___ any compulsory redundancies be made before the end of the year.

explanation.en: After a negative adverbial at the start of the sentence we invert the auxiliary and the subject. Only will works with be made.

items.prompt: Anyone interested in voluntary severance is ___ to speak to HR before the end of the month.

explanation.en: Be encouraged to do something is a polite way of recommending an action. Is persuaded or is convinced would say that staff have already been won over, which makes no sense in an invitation.

items.prompt: Those who leave will receive a generous package, ___ of the length of their service.

explanation.en: Irrespective of means whatever the length of service. Depending needs on, not of, and regarding of is not English.
